chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbaat and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, all together, from al-Hakam ibn Miskeen, from Jameel ibn Darraj, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'When the slave marries the free woman, so his children are free, and when the free man marries the slave woman, so his children are free'.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of children when one parent is a slave and the other is free?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'freedom of the child' (hurriyyat al-walad) in mixed-status marriages, ensuring that offspring inherit the free status of the free parent regardless of which parent is enslaved. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it prevents the perpetuation of slavery through lineage and aligns with the broader Islamic emphasis on emancipation. The narration, transmitted via Jamil ibn Darraj, reflects the practical legal applications discussed by the Imams regarding family law and social mobility.
